notes.title: Grail to the Thief Goes Free to Play!
notes.content: For All To Play is excited to announce that our blind accessible audio game, Grail to the Thief, has gone free to play in recognition of World Sight Day, an annually observed global event meant to draw attention on blindness and vision impairment.

notes.title: Grail to the Thief Going Free to Play Beginning October 10th!
notes.content: For All To Play is excited to announce that our blind accessible audio game, Grail to the Thief, is going free to play beginning Thursday, October 10, 2019 in recognition of World Sight Day, an annually observed global event meant to draw attention on blindness and vision impairment.

notes.title: Demo Now Available!

A [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/383920/]Grail to the Thief demo[/url] is now available for Windows, Mac and Linux so you can try the game before you buy it.
